description: Submit an employer-authored feedback report about a canonical subject person (use the roster tool for ids). DEV-3168 balanced shapes: omit assessment (legacy) and severity + report stay REQUIRED, recording a NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT concern; with assessment, severity present <=> a concern is flagged — POSITIVE never takes severity/suggestedAction, NEEDS_IMPROVEMENT requires severity, MIXED takes severity only when flagging, and any flagged concern requires a report body. Optional anchored ratings default to Not rated. suggestedAction is a recommendation only — nothing executes automatically. Receipt-backed: the receipt completes inside the submit transaction, so a crash-retry replays the SAME report instead of filing a twin. Requires job_feedback:write.

assessment.description: Omit for the legacy concern shape (severity + report required).

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

report.description: The ONE feedback body; required whenever a concern is flagged.

severity.description: Present <=> the submission flags a concern (enters the triage lane).

name: opentrain_job_feedback_submit
